records.issue_text: force: true in create_top_topics and create_topic_embeds migrations drops existing tables; adding it to the already-shipped create_top_topics migration destroys top_topics data on environments that rerun it
records.rationale: Verified in the diff: `create_table :topic_embeds, force: true` and the change of the existing `create_table :top_topics` line to `create_table :top_topics, force: true`. Modifying an already-shipped migration to add `force: true` is a real, specific data-loss hazard: any environment where that migration re-runs (or new environments bootstrapped with existing top_topics data) will have the table dropped and recreated. It's not incorrect behavior in the new code itself but a concrete migration-safety concern a maintainer must consider before shipping.
